Grit; 6 Sharp; Near (15 ft); melee. Heavy: each Strike costs an Attack and an Interact Action. Two-hander: needs both hands free. Cleave: if a Strike kills its target, the unused damage carries over to another enemy of your choice within Close Range (5 ft).

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.138
